note: Evidence checks for T20I match dates. Cricsheet is secondary, validation-only evidence and never an official record. No original date is changed.

timestamp.suffix_note: delivery_ist_time carries a 'UTC' suffix although the column is named IST; only the date part is compared, within the tolerance.

cricsheet.identity: same normalised team pair, first-innings batting team and first-innings total equal

independence.rule: Internal checks can create a conflict but never add to the agreeing-source count.

primary_set_rule: OFFICIAL_VERIFIED, plus matches dated on or before test_core_end whose class is DATE_CONSISTENT_ACROSS_SOURCES
